name: Villagatón (Spain)
description: Square blue flag with a white triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the fly, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villagatón (a star on blue above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Villagatón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
